# Carolina Knowledge Center

> > A comprehensive science education resource platform offering hands-on labs, lesson plans, and professional development for K-12 educators aligned with NGSS and AP standards.

Carolina Knowledge Center serves as the educational hub for Carolina's science education products and services. The platform provides curated content spanning life sciences, physical sciences, earth sciences, and interdisciplinary STEM topics, with extensive support for classroom implementation through lab guides, safety protocols, and teacher professional development resources.

## Key Topics

- NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards)
- Hands-on lab activities
- Life science
- Physical science
- Earth science
- Lab skills and techniques
- Biotechnology
- Environmental science
- Lab safety protocols
- Classroom organisms (Drosophila, Brine Shrimp, Wisconsin Fast Plants)
- AP Physics and AP courses
- Microbiology
- Forensics
- Phenomena-based learning
- Teacher professional development

## Science Disciplines & Archives

- [All Science Archives](https://knowledge.carolina.com/discipline): Central hub for science educational resources covering earth, life, and physical sciences with AP course alignment
- [Life Science Activities & Articles](https://knowledge.carolina.com/discipline/life-science): Hands-on labs covering biology, microbiology, anatomy, biotechnology for K-12 students
- [Chemistry & Physics Articles & Activities](https://knowledge.carolina.com/discipline/physical-science): Physical science hands-on investigations and STEM activities for chemistry and physics
- [Earth & Space, Environmental Science Archives](https://knowledge.carolina.com/discipline/earth-environmental): Educational resources covering plate tectonics, ecology, climate change, and environmental science
- [Interdisciplinary Archives](https://knowledge.carolina.com/discipline/interdisciplinary): Interdisciplinary STEM resources including forensics and lab skills for middle and high school

## Lab Skills, Safety & Techniques

- [Safety Archives](https://knowledge.carolina.com/professional-growth/safety): Lab safety protocols, PPE guides, chemical storage, and risk management resources for educators
- [Lab Skills Archives](https://knowledge.carolina.com/professional-growth/labskills): Laboratory techniques covering microscopy, microbiology, chemistry, and forensics education
- [Activities Archives](https://knowledge.carolina.com/professional-growth/activities): Lab activities and hands-on experiments for biology, chemistry, genetics, and dissection
- [Care Guides for Living Organisms](https://knowledge.carolina.com/discipline/life-science/biology/care-guides-for-living-organisms): Care instructions for classroom organisms including plants, algae, and dinoflagellates

## Curriculum & Lesson Planning

- [Carolina Essentials Archives](https://knowledge.carolina.com/carolina-essentials): NGSS-aligned phenomena-based lesson plans for earth, life, and physical sciences K-12
- [Professional Growth Archives](https://knowledge.carolina.com/professional-growth): Teacher professional development covering NGSS, biotechnology, lab skills, and webinars

## Educational Resources & Tools

- [Product Resources Archives](https://knowledge.carolina.com/product-resources): Product resources including lab kit guides, microscope instructions, and buying guides
- [Infographics Library](https://knowledge.carolina.com/infographics-library): Educational infographics clarifying lab safety, ecosystems, anatomy, and biology concepts

## About Carolina

- [Why Carolina](https://knowledge.carolina.com/who-we-are): Carolina company overview, mission, and commitment to science education
- [Our Brands](https://knowledge.carolina.com/our-brands): Carolina brand partners and product catalog for science education materials
